title: Satay with Crunchy Fried Shallots
description: A Malaysian-inspired appetizer featuring skewers of satay chicken, served with a side of crunchy fried shallots and creamy mascarpone sauce.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the chicken pieces onto skewers and brush with the satay spice blend.
Grill the satay for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat the vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced shallots and fry until crispy, stirring frequently.
Drain the fried shallots on paper towels and season with salt.
In a separate pan, melt the mascarpone cheese over low heat.
Stir in the chopped peanuts and cook until the sauce is smooth.
Serve the grilled satay with the crispy fried shallots and creamy mascarpone sauce.
Garnish with additional peanuts and satay spice blend, if desired.
